subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers + action-form — the chat↔dashboard loop

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this bundled dashboard Living Answers/action-form stack now, including the dependency graph and security-sensitive dashboard surfaces, or require it to be rebased and narrowed after #101098 lands?
rationale: The branch is a large new bundled plugin capability with security-sensitive prompt dispatch and dependency graph changes, so automation cannot decide the product/security acceptance boundary.

options.title: Rebase and narrow first
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase after #101098, remove local artifacts, resolve the dependency approval path, and provide real behavior proof before final product/security review.

options.title: Sponsor current stack
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly authorize the dependency graph/security review path and review the cumulative stack despite the size and conflicts.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: If the bundled dashboard direction is not ready, pause or close this PR while keeping #101820/#101821 as roadmap discussion.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow first
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase after #101098, remove local artifacts, resolve the dependency approval path, and provide real behavior proof before final product/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-main history signal on adjacent Control UI plugin integration surfaces inspected for this review.
